verses.text: Praise the LORD! Blessed are those who fear the LORD and take real joy in what he commands.
Their children will be strong in the land. The generation of those who live uprightly will be blessed.
Their home is full of wealth, and their righteousness lasts forever.
Light breaks through the dark for those who live uprightly, the gracious, the merciful, and the righteous.
Things go well for someone who lends generously. They’ll handle their case justly.
They’ll never be shaken. People will remember the righteous forever.
Bad news won’t scare them. Their hearts are steady because they trust the LORD.
Their hearts are firm. They won’t be afraid when they finally look on their enemies.
They give freely to the poor. Their righteousness lasts forever. Their horn will rise high with honor.
The wicked will see it and get upset. They’ll grind their teeth and waste away. Everything the wicked hoped for will come to nothing.
